definitions.reference: All houses counted from LAGNA, not Rasi.
lord_4_strong_if_any: conjoined with a planet in own sign or exalted
in nakshatra of a planet that is in own sign or exalted

inputs.property_type: house | house_plot | vacant_plot | agricultural_land | commercial | rental

rules.name: Husband's 4th afflicted
rules.result: Property delayed - may come only around 45-50+ or later; not fully denied (other dasas/planet strength can deliver).

rules.name: Husband's blocking period
condition_any: current mahadasa lord is lord of 6, 8 or 12
transit Saturn in 12th, 1st or 2nd from Moon (Sade Sati)
transit Saturn in 8th from Moon (Ashtama Sani)
transit Saturn in 4th from Moon (Ardhashtama Sani)
rules.result: Property does not materialise in his name during this period even if the chart is otherwise strong; long dasas (Saturn 19y, Mercury 17y) prolong it.

rules.name: Wife's 4th lord stronger
rules.example: Husband's 4th lord in kendra/trikona, wife's 4th lord in own sign
rules.result: Property appreciates faster and gets developed further in wife's name.

rules.name: Wife's chart suitable
rules.condition: lord_4 strong (any criterion) AND lord_4 not in 6/8/12
rules.result: Buy freely in her name; property grows.

rules.name: Wife's chart unsuitable
rules.aggravator: current mahadasa is of wife's lord_4

rules.name: 4th lord in 6th
rules.result: Risk of litigation, or owner relocates and someone else occupies the property (only rent received).

rules.name: Benefic protection of 4th
rules.condition: any benefics_for_4th occupies or aspects house 4
rules.result: 4th house strong; property bought in this person's name is stable and lasting.

rules.name: Short-term investment
rules.result: Sells quickly in husband's name even if his chart is weak.

rules.name: Strong Mars - illiquid property
condition_any: Mars conjoined with a planet in own sign or exalted
rules.result: Property acquired late in life; very hard to sell even in distress - banks/creditors reluctant to take it.

rules.name: Venus decides house construction
rules.special_case: husband Venus retrograde AND wife Venus in kendra/trikona/own/exalted and not retrograde/debilitated -> wife's name mandatory
rules.result_if_ignored: Construction quarrels (contractor, engineer, suppliers), money drain, illness after completion.

rules.name: 4th-11th lord connection
rules.condition: lord_4 and lord_11 connected (conjunction, mutual aspect, exchange, or same planet)
rules.result: Full occupancy, good rent, profitable resale.

cross_links.ketu_12th_from_ketu: K12-MARS and K12-MERCURY also advise against building/buying in own name - merge with PROP-01 as additional affliction signals.

resolution_order: 5. Else score PROP-01, 02, 03, 05 by weight and pick the higher-scoring name
open_questions_for_implementation: Use full Vedic special aspects (Mars 4/8, Jupiter 5/9, Saturn 3/10, Rahu/Ketu 5/9)?
Numeric strength scale for comparisons (suggest: exalted 5, own 4, kendra/trikona 3, neutral 2, dusthana 1, debilitated 0)
